scope: All s3/s3control/dynamodb/rds/docdb provider types plus EC2 aws_ebs_*, aws_snapshot_create_volume_permission and aws_volume_attachment. Prefix does not mean EBS Direct SDK ownership.
evidence_rule: Static required API coverage and fixture declarations are not Terraform or native consumer success evidence. Every record remains unverified until actually exercised; non-fixture types are an exact remaining lifecycle list, not a claim of missing owners.
api_evidence_scope: required_apis copies the authoritative record's source_file_apis, not a separately proven transitive helper-call closure. The authoritative inventory retains registration, API disposition and unresolved-call evidence. Empty API lists do not establish zero dependencies.
